evidence: Cic. Mur. 20: neque ambitiōsus imperātor neque invidus (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Its first sense is “going round”, of canvassing for office.
Under the republic, the canvassing of a candidate; then the striving for office and honour.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
